nace-ai/drex-max-v1.1._note: Tested on Nace's own API (https://console.nace.ai/v1/systemone, model drex-max-v1.1, released 2026-10-28). Data policy from https://drex.nace.ai/terms: 'No training by default'; Standard mode retains 'job Inputs and Outputs' until deletion (unclear whether decision requests are covered -> half points); zero-retention mode available. Weights: Hugging Face has only nace-ai/drex-max-v1, not v1.1. Usage: OpenRouter weekly requests for Drex Max (the only public usage figure). Cost: input tokens x $0.03/M (Nace responses report tokens, not cost).
